prompt: Draw me a congressional district that connects my house to the good barbecue place across town. Describe the shape.
response: Easy. We draw her like a shotgun, buddy. Your house is the stock — nice fat blob wrapped around your street. Then we run the barrel straight down Route 9, one block wide, hugging the road the whole way so she stays connected clean across town, all the way to the barbecue joint, and that's the muzzle. Long skinny barrel, chunky stock. A man could hang it on his wall. Perfectly legal district — and now the smoked ribs live inside it.
